title: Lease Modifications - ASC 842
learning_objectives: Determine when modification is separate contract

content.definition: A change to the terms and conditions of a contract that results in a change in scope or consideration of lease

criteria: Consideration increases by amount commensurate with standalone price for increase in scope

actions: Remeasure lease liability using revised lease payments and revised discount rate
Adjust ROU asset by amount of remeasurement

special_cases.treatment: Decrease ROU asset and liability, recognize gain/loss for difference

special_cases.scenario: Modification only changes payments (no scope change)

content.lessor_accounting: Apply finance or operating lease classification tests to modified lease as if it were new lease

example.scenario: Lessee extends lease term from 5 to 7 years
calculation: Remeasure liability with all remaining payments (years 1-7) at new rate
Adjust ROU asset for change in liability

content.cpa_exam_tip: Most tested: Extension scenarios requiring remeasurement. Test for separate contract first (additional space at market rate = separate). Otherwise, remeasure existing lease.

key_points: Modification = change in scope or consideration
Separate contract if adds ROU at standalone price
Otherwise remeasure lease liability with revised terms and rate
Adjust ROU asset for remeasurement amount
